A triangular plate with mass $M$ occupies the region $D$ enclosed between the $x$-axis and the lines $x=1$ and $y=2x.$
The mass density at each point is proportional to its distance from the $x$-axis. Find the moment of inertia of the plate about the line $x=-2.$
